name: editions
description: “Which edition?” guide: recommended translations and editions of Catholic classics, with verified ISBNs.

records.label: Best for reading & study
records.edition: RSV-2CE (Revised Standard Version, Second Catholic Edition)
records.note: Accurate, literary, formal-equivalence English; the text of the Ignatius Study Bible and the one most quoted in English catechesis.

records.label: Best study notes (NT)

records.label: Study edition (NABRE)
records.note: A reading and study Bible. U.S. Mass readings use a distinct approved lectionary based on the NAB.

records.label: Traditional
records.note: The classic English Catholic Bible from the Vulgate; Baronius and TAN both print durable editions. Free online at DRBO.org.

records.label: Literary
